subject: Re: Kickoff: Dichotomy of Control for reliable automation agents
body:
Status heading into the final stretch.

Done: Carmen reproduced the tabular results. On Bandit, DoC holds near-optimal return where the dt baseline collapses, matching the paper's reported gap; FrozenLake reproduces as well from the create_dataset.sh offline sets.

In flight: the neural DoC run on the ops simulator. First runs show DoC ahead of DT by 12% mean return but with high seed variance, so we need the full 5-seed sweep before we can call it. Linnea Yamada is committed at 60% to this project for June 2026 to land the neural DoC runs before the June 8 wrap.

Risk: if two of the five seeds land inside DT's variance band, the go/no-go gets murky. My recommendation would then be 'adopt for high-stochasticity workflows only'. Flagging now so the June readout language is no surprise.

Deshawn
